blurb: Guests can enjoy animal encounters such as dolphin, beluga, penguin, and shark experiences, as well as rides and shows with reserved seating options. Vacation packages include park admission and hotel accommodations with various add-ons. The park provides amenities like wheelchair and stroller rentals, designated smoking areas, and free Wi-Fi.
